summary: Cozy Cloud is a self-hosted personal cloud platform designed to help you manage and synchronise your files, notes, contacts, passwords, and documents in one place. It operates as a centralised groupware solution for keeping your personal data under your direct control. Because concrete architectural details beyond its basic scope are sparse, it functions similarly to other self-hosted productivity and file-sync suites.
goodFor: This software is a suitable fit if you want to experiment with a lightweight Node.js-based personal cloud alternative for basic file and data synchronisation.
watchOut: Activity and release history for this project are currently non-existent, suggesting it may be abandoned, unmaintained, or an early experimental concept lacking community support.
deployNotes: As a Node.js application, you will typically need to run it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination and configure persistent storage for your uploaded files and user data.
